claims.statement: A nonempty finite carrier, closed full table, two-sided identity/inverses and all-triple associativity are checked before lattice arithmetic. Validated S3 and Q8 are actual finite groups; their exact products are table lookups.
claims.limits: Finite represented groups only; cubic table-validation work has no service resource cap. This is no derivation of a physical gauge group.

claims.statement: On the declared open rectangle or torus cell complex, nonidentity plaquette products witness nonflatness. Flat open connections are tree-gauge trivial; flat torus connections have commuting based cycles and are gauge trivial exactly when both cycles are identity. The Python host implements these checks and verifies returned trivializing gauges.
dependencies: Finite-group axioms admitted by full table checks
Declared rectangular cell complex and its elementary path relations
claims.limits: Independent controls exhaust1296 S3 open2x2 states and1024 flat Z2 torus3x3 states, plus1024 selected nonflat states; no general formal proof of Python.

claims.statement: A certificate is accepted only after recomputing its stated nonidentity plaquette, globally trivializing gauge, or full-flatness plus nonidentity closed-loop witness. Plaquette rotations and reversal are allowed with matching ordered products; correct verdict text alone is insufficient.
claims.limits: Assumes a valid admitted Connection and successful parsed input processing. Raw JSON duplicate keys remain decoder responsibility; malformed input can raise untyped exceptions.

claims.statement: Four identity links have identity product, so those multiplications may be skipped while all other plaquettes are checked. A gauge transformation preserves flatness but can eliminate every such shortcut. Lean source proves only the identity-link remark under supplied group laws.
claims.limits: One narrow written Lean lemma and historical reports, not a fresh kernel pass or proof of the whole checker. No gauge-invariant or general token saving follows.

claims.statement: Five retained C017 cases and15 retained solution records can be replayed, yielding10 accepts and5 rejects, while10 further payloads remain absent. Historical table recount sums original flags and author annotations; it cannot establish prompt superiority, model ranking or unaided accuracy.
claims.limits: Exact archive suite43 and capstone pass. Current checkout custody failures remain. C045-C050 historical checker execution and paid model trials were not rerun.

findings.statement: Current MANIFEST has52 raw mismatches among80 entries and SHA256SUMS53 among81;21 and22 remain after LF normalization. Current suite40pass/3fail and capstone fails first on c045 source hash. Exact ZIP manifests pass and its suite43/capstone pass; first archive renderer attempt was obstructed by OS temporary-directory permissions, then passed with workspace temp.
findings.recommended_action: Preserve both editions and identify transformations explicitly; do not rewrite historical hashes to disguise changed source bytes.

findings.statement: tools/render_paper.py now searches for an author starting Bare Metal Anchor, but actual manuscript and retained fixture start Jeremy. Fresh current test and direct public fixture raise StopIteration before external rendering; archived Jeremy-prefix renderer passes.
findings.recommended_action: In a future editable edition, use explicit metadata or robust header parsing and retain a regression test against the actual manuscript.

findings.statement: The claimed typed refusal for malformed inputs is not total: nonobject case input raises AttributeError; a certificate vertex containing5000 decimal digits raises uncaught ValueError. Direct API float-coordinate aliases also compare equal to integer coordinates, outside the annotated type domain; no valid-carrier mathematical false acceptance was established.
findings.recommended_action: Any reusable workflow adapter must admit shape, exact scalar types and size limits and normalize expected parse errors into explicit refusals.

findings.statement: When invoked with UTF-8 mode enabled, the retained renderer test calls subprocess.run without capture_output and then writes completed.stdout/stderr, which are None. The successful archived suite was deliberately run with -X utf8=0, exercising its actual renderer body without this broken recursive branch.
findings.recommended_action: Use capture_output=True or avoid writing uncaptured streams in a future test repair; keep the scoped invocation explicit.

findings.statement: Current lean-toolchain is4.35.0, while archived pin, manuscript and historical records state4.34.0-rc1. Named/full census bodies have one theorem versus26 declarations; neither is evidence of a current kernel execution or complete-host proof.
findings.recommended_action: A future Lean replay must bind the actual source and compiler version and record fresh output separately from historical reports.

findings.statement: The change log documents withdrawal of unsupported immune-filter effect sizes, benchmark totals without retained runners/receipts, and wrong earlier holonomy heuristics. Current finite checker and explicit historical audit are useful. PDF/candidate wording, later publication metadata and renamed current paths refer to different editions.
findings.recommended_action: Retain the corrected finite checker and evidence audit as the contribution; do not reuse withdrawn effect sizes or label the cited historical counts as measured workflow benefit.
